```python
def transform(grid):
    # Find the rectangular panel of 1s.
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    panel = [row[c0:c1 + 1] for row in grid[r0:r1 + 1]]

    # Rotate the panel counterclockwise.
    out = [list(row) for row in zip(*panel)][::-1]

    # The isolated markers label three corners of the rotated panel.
    markers = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r, row in enumerate(grid)
               for c, v in enumerate(row) if v not in (0, 1)]
    left = min(markers, key=lambda p: p[1])
    right = max(markers, key=lambda p: p[1])
    bottom = max(markers, key=lambda p: p[0])
    out[1][1] = left[2]
    out[1][-2] = right[2]
    out[-2][-2] = bottom[2]
    return out
```
